title: Understanding Complete Linkage
text: Complete linkage in hierarchical clustering considers the maximum distance between elements in two clusters. Think about how this might affect which teams are grouped together.

title: Calculating Distances
text: To determine which teams are clustered together, calculate the Euclidean distance between Team O-Ski and the other teams. Remember, the formula for Euclidean distance between two points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2) is $$\sqrt{\left(x2-x1\right)^2+\left(y2-y1\right)^2}$$.

title: Distance from Team O-Ski to Team SantaQlaus
text: What is the Euclidean distance between Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$ and Team SantaQlaus $$(3,1)$$?

title: Distance from Team O-Ski to Team Pandas
text: What is the Euclidean distance between Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$ and Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$?

title: Distance from Team O-Ski to Team Ice-berk
text: What is the Euclidean distance between Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$ and Team Ice-berk $$(1,5)$$?

title: Comparing Distances
text: Now that you have the distances, consider which team is closest to Team O-Ski. This will help you determine the initial clusters formed using complete linkage.
